title: Dynamics in large scale geometry
summary: We investigate the large scale geometry of certain metric spaces through the lens of dynamics. Our approach establishes a close connection between large scale dynamical phenomena and operator algebras by characterizing various large scale dynamic behaviors in terms of GNS representations of the uniform Roe algebras arising from natural canonical states. Our dynamical systems are given by the Stone-Čech boundary of metric spaces together with their inverse semigroup of partial translations.
